validity.segment_name: Lake City 1st Branch Line Abandonment and Capacity Replacement Project
validity.researcher_notes: Lake City 1st Branch replacement is a real, FERC-certificated interstate replacement segment (docket CP20-504). FERC approved the project Oct 2020, construction started Oct 2021, and the project was partially completed 2022-10 and fully completed 2024-01 (per EIA Aug 2026). The pipeline is a capacity replacement segment on Northern Natural's Iowa system. The old Lake City 1st branch line (approx 29.63 miles of 16-inch line) was abandoned in place; the new segment replaces lost capacity via uprating and a new pipeline segment. No idling or secondary abandonment found. Status remains operating. [ORCHESTRATOR AUDIT 2026-09-15] Tier arithmetic corrected (tier 'high' -> 'medium'; independent True -> False): this record's evidence resolves to 1 distinct publisher(s) (eia.gov), and rule 4 counts publishers, not URLs — every EIA release is ONE origin, as are multiple filings by one filer or multiple notices in one docket. The FINDING is unchanged; only the confidence claim was wrong.
